nodes.Name: timeHistogram
nodes.DocComment:
timeHistogram represents a distribution of durations in
nanoseconds.

The accuracy and range of the histogram is defined by the
timeHistSubBucketBits and timeHistNumBuckets constants.

It is an HDR histogram with exponentially-distributed
buckets and linearly distributed sub-buckets.

The histogram is safe for concurrent reads and writes.

nodes.Name: record
nodes.DocComment:
record adds the given duration to the distribution.

Disallow preemptions and stack growths because this function
may run in sensitive locations.

go:nosplit

nodes.Name: write
nodes.DocComment: write dumps the histogram to the passed metricValue as a float64 histogram.

nodes.Name: timeHistogramMetricsBuckets
nodes.DocComment:
timeHistogramMetricsBuckets generates a slice of boundaries for
the timeHistogram. These boundaries are represented in seconds,
not nanoseconds like the timeHistogram represents durations.
